intended_object: The kernel of a weight χ : L → R of a Lie module M over a nilpotent Lie algebra L, in the case where weights are linear. It is the R-submodule {x ∈ L | χ(x) = 0} of L. Inferred from the docstring and the name.
explanation: The definition is `LinearMap.ker` applied to the weight seen as a linear map L →ₗ[R] R. That linear map is `Weight.toLinear`, and the `LinearWeights` hypothesis is what makes it linear. This is exactly the standard kernel of a linear weight. It is stated in the generality the module works in: any commutative ring R, any nilpotent Lie algebra L, and any Lie module M whose weights are linear. Linearity is needed for the kernel to be a submodule, so these hypotheses are not an unnecessary restriction. The abbreviation adds no new mathematics; it is a convenient name for `LinearMap.ker` of the coerced weight.
